title: Agent Configuration State
description: Complete caller-scoped connection configuration visible after sync. Secrets are never returned. The seller keys this state by its own agent identity and the stable authenticated caller principal.

notification_configs.description: Current agent-level webhook subscribers. authentication.credentials is always omitted because it is write-only.

reporting_destinations.description: Current reusable reporting destination bindings and setup states. destination_id and destination_ref values MUST each be unique within this caller-scoped array.
